description: Arrival points and routes of the peopling of the world (spec peopling.md, sections 3 and 4), provisional until the Markdown records with cards exist. A route starts at an earlier point, or at the African front, and its points are reached in order; bce is the approximate year BCE of the earliest well-accepted evidence, debated where an older date is argued about.
